      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",

      "evidence": "Changes getdescriptorinfo output in src/rpc/output_script.cpp as a direct result of descriptor object changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change to getdescriptorinfo output is the behavior of the underlying descriptor engine exposed via RPC rather than an RPC framework change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test and benchmark files only to update them for descriptor and BIP32 derivation path API changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to fuzz tests, unit tests, and benchmarks merely update test cases to follow the modified descriptor interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Substantially refactors src/util/bip32.cpp and src/util/bip32.h (+261/-38) to introduce structured KeyPath and KeyPathElement primitives.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces raw vector<uint32_t> derivation paths with structured KeyPath abstractions in shared BIP32 utilities. This improves type safety and derivation path parsing across consumers, though the primary motivation is descriptor-layer functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Descriptors label, heavily alters src/script/descriptor.cpp, and updates wallet storage and scriptpubkeyman handling for multipath descriptors.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Preserves multipath descriptor strings instead of prematurely expanding and discarding them during parsing. As stated in the description, 'Once we finish parsing such a string, the multipath elements are lost... This means that we are unable to return the multipath string for such descriptors'; representing them in a single object resolves this limitation and unblocks follow-on work like #36443."
    }
